name: Zombie Police ~Zombie Keiji to Odoru Christmas~
original_name: Zombie Police ～ゾンビ刑事と踊るクリスマス～
source:
She's the only one who can conduct this investigation... (because she's a zombie)

A mystery adventure game featuring the odd-couple buddy duo of newbie detective Tamura Yasu and zombie detective Kabane Akemi as they take on cases together.

Based on the testimonies and evidence collected, you will ultimately deduce the truth behind each case.
The game features multiple endings that vary depending on your deductions.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825070/Zombie_Police_Christmas_Dancing_with_Police_Zombies/]Steam page[/url]]
